rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260)
rules.requirement: Jersey City administers and enforces a municipal Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260) through the Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations and the Rent Leveling Board. The passages do not state the cap formula or percentage. Properties with 1-4 units are exempt, and owners may request other permitted exemptions. Tenants may file Illegal Rent Petitions.

unverifiable_exemptions: Other exemptions permitted under the ordinance, which require a Rent Control Exemption Request to the Office for review
coverage.summary: Covers rental properties with 5 or more units. All 1-4 unit properties are exempt.
coverage.other_conditions: Other exemptions may be granted on request if the owner meets the criteria for a permitted exemption.

rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt; other permitted exemptions are available through a Rent Control Exemption Request.
rules.effective_date_note: The passages give no effective date or enactment date for Chapter 260.
rules.quoted_span: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control
rules.review_note: The passages give no cap percentage or formula. They only mention a CPI chart as a resource. The ordinance text itself was not retrieved. Any preemption by the NJ FAIR Act is not addressed in the passages.
rules.source_notes: Secondary description from the city's Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations webpage, not the ordinance text.
